purpose: Define lossless forecast lead identity shared by L1 acquisition and L2 persistence without truncation, guessing, or silent coercion.

l1_acquisition_lead_hours.rule: Acquisition lead input is a strict non-negative integer number of hours.

l2_lead_seconds.rule: Persisted successor lead identity is exact non-negative integer seconds.

invariants: Never use int(), round(), floor(), ceil() or string parsing to coerce a fractional or malformed lead into validity.
When acquisition_lead_hours is present, lead_seconds must equal acquisition_lead_hours * 3600 exactly.
When run_time_utc and valid_time_utc are present, their exact whole-second difference must equal lead_seconds.
Boolean values are not integers for this contract even though Python bool subclasses int.
Missing, contradictory, fractional, naive-time or non-UTC lead identity fails closed.
